Announcing: Knitting ER, A Virtual Workshop with Patty Lyons!

September 24, 2026 | By Ann Shayne and Kay Gardiner Modern Daily Knitting
SHARE
  • . External Link. Opens in new window.
  • . External Link. Opens in new window.
2 Comments

Dear everybody,

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 4:22
Instaread

It’s a joyous day when we get to announce an opportunity to learn virtually with Patty Lyons, the force of nature who has devoted her life to enlightening and uplifting knitters—especially the millions of us who are self taught, like Patty herself.

Time spent with Patty is always—always—an eye-opening, mind-blowing voyage of discovery.

This virtual class started brewing back in April when, as a speaker at Nash Yarn Fest, Patty took us behind the scenes of her new book, Patty Lyons’ Knitting ER. It’s all about fixing mistakes.

Hey, we thought: we make mistakes—so many mistakes! So we asked: um, Patty, you’re going to teach a virtual workshop for MDK on this, aren’t you? And lucky for all of us, Patty said yes.

Previous MDK virtual workshops with Patty have been game changers, garnering rave reviews from participants, who took the time to write us nice notes like:

Patty was an excellent instructor—very engaging and funny! It felt like her book came to life right in front of me!

Anything Patty Lyons has to offer is wonderful. She is a great teacher.

Best class ever! 

I have been knitting for a long time but want to be a better knitter and really improve the product and my knitting experience. Tremendous value for money.

[Blushing on Patty’s behalf.]

Patty’s in-person workshops tend to sell out immediately, so this chance to learn with her virtually is a special opportunity that we’re proud to offer.

We sure hope you can join us on November 6. Read on for more details, or go straight to the registration page and sign up. (Reminder: MDK Society members save 10% when using the member coupon code at checkout.)

. External Link. Opens in new window.

Details

Date: Friday, November 6, 2026

Time: Noon-2:00 p.m. Eastern time

Location: Zoom—this is a virtual event. The talk will be recorded, and participants will have access to watch and re-watch for as long as they like. Your order confirmation email will include a PDF download with the Zoom link, and we will send email reminders the week of the workshop.

This talk does not include a copy of Patty Lyons’ Knitting ER. The book is available separately here.

The Class

In this class, Patty will focus first and foremost on foundational fixes. You’ll learn how to master the basics: how to read your knitting, how to unknit (tink), and how to rip (frog) without tears.

You’ll also learn a few fancy tricks, including two ways to fix garter without turning your work or dropping your hook (yes a crochet hook is involved), plus how to fix a dropped edge stitch in any stitch pattern. And Patty’s favorite: using a small needle to safely rip down in any stitch pattern aka the Safety Frog.

The Book

Patty’s new book is not included or required for this virtual class, but we wholeheartedly recommend it as a reference for every knitter. Click here to read all about it and order your copy.

Our Workshop Leader

. External Link. Opens in new window.. External Link. Opens in new window.

Patty Lyons is a nationally recognized knitting teacher and technique expert, known for teaching the “why” in addition to the “how” and making us all mindful knitters.

Wherever knitters are gathered, there is a good chance of finding Patty. She teaches all over the United States at guilds, shops, festivals, and retreats. You can find Patty on the regular at her website. External Link. Opens in new window.. External Link.
